scope: Publish exact source/results bytes with bounded, reconstructible byte chunks.

summary.scope: Publish the closed three-level U fields and six final normal-contact trace audits.

u-nonlinear-three-level-fields-v2.scope: Reconstruct nonlinear U equilibrium and compare objective fields across resolved contact meshes.
u-nonlinear-three-level-fields-v2.limitations: Every retained accepted-step residual record is checked; only final complete fields were saved. Independent nonlinear bulk equilibrium is reconstructed with the retained final nodal contact forces, not a missing friction history. Proper finite frames and direct P2 deformation-gradient evaluation at common material points avoid stress interpolation and infinitesimal-rotation assumptions. The declared axis and semantic geometry hashes distinguish coupled, fixed-body pad and fixed-pad body studies. Body CAD/volume and pad geometry/volume/contact resolution still require their own separated checks. Probe norms are diagnostics rather than continuum integrals; two levels cannot establish a tail. Discrete masses are recorded without density retuning. Full history/contact reconstruction, separated axes, refined contact references, native finite footprints, actual Franka, feedback and verified warmed accuracy/cost remain separate requirements.

u-nonlinear-final-contact-traces-v1.scope: Audit final nonlinear U contact traces against independently balanced saved fields.
u-nonlinear-final-contact-traces-v1.limitations: Final normal IPC stencils and forces are independently rebuilt; shear is the unchanged saved total contact force minus that normal force, not an independent friction-history audit. The original final/history force budgets are inherited only from the specified closed field audits. Shoe groups are physical source identities, not independently identified continuum islands. Disjoint body stencil supports permit exact source attribution; ambiguous nodes are rejected. Sample force divided by current incident-triangle lumped area is a discrete density, not continuum pressure/contact area. The1e-8N threshold affects reported active counts/areas only, never forces, norms, raw maxima or acceptance. No pressure convergence or goal completion follows from these diagnostics.

limitations: Three coupled U levels retain12.21% last tensor change and5.34% raw lower peak change. Fixed-body pad7-to9 tensor change1.20% does not establish contact pressure convergence: left maximum discrete normal density increases25.48%, and left/right active lumped areas decrease12.80%/8.31%. All six final normal contact stencils are independently rebuilt and both physical shoe wrenches retained. Saved total-minus-normal shear is explicitly not an independent friction-history reconstruction. Lumped sample-force densities and source identities are not continuum pressure/area/islands. All original raw fields/maxima, materials, physical load laws and force budgets remain. Full physical convergence, regularization/history, model/feedback and warmed accuracy/cost acceptance remain open. Files of at least50MB are preserved as exact ordered32MiB byte ranges, individually gzip-compressed, with original/part/stored SHA256 and offsets. Join decompressed ranges in index order to restore the original file exactly; no records are reduced or excluded. Runtime staging uses hard links for unchanged small originals.
